{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and cast to float
# First, check for the QA rows
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Found", len(qa_rows), "QA rows with revenue 999999.99")

# Remove them
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99'].copy()

# Now parse revenue as float
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the fix
print("Mean revenue after cleaning:", df_clean['revenue'].mean())

# Now, focus on converted == 1
converted_df = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("Number of -1 values in customer_age among converted:", (converted_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Drop rows with -1 in customer_age for age mean
converted_valid_age = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_valid_age['customer_age'].mean()

print("Mean age of converted customers with valid age:", mean_age)"}
